description: A powerful local HTTP bridge granting AI agents (like Antigravity) advanced system-level capabilities on a Windows host.

endpoints.GET /api/system/info: Returns OS, architecture, CPU count, memory, and disk usage.
endpoints.GET /api/system/processes: Returns a list of all running processes with PID, memory, and CPU metrics.
endpoints.GET /api/system/wmi_query: Executes a raw WMI query. Example query: '?query=SELECT * FROM Win32_VideoController'.

endpoints.POST /api/system/exec: DANGEROUS: Executes raw Python script in the bridge process. Returns stdout/stderr. Requires {'script': 'python code'}.

endpoints.GET /api/ui/screenshot: Takes a screenshot and returns it as base64 jpeg.
endpoints.GET /api/ui/windows: Enumerates all visible windows (HWND, title, rect).
endpoints.POST /api/ui/window/focus: Brings window to foreground. Requires {'hwnd': int}.

endpoints.POST /api/memory/read: Reads process memory. Requires {'pid': int, 'address': int/hex_str, 'size': int}. Returns base64 and hex data.
endpoints.POST /api/memory/write: Writes process memory. Requires {'pid': int, 'address': int/hex_str, 'data_hex': str}.

usage_instructions: To interact with the host, construct HTTP requests using your `read_url_content` or `run_command` (via curl/Invoke-RestMethod) tools targeting these endpoints.
